waste_details.reason_for_no_provision: This is not relevant for the application. This is a cladding replacement application.

description:
The proposal is to undertake remedial work to partially replace existing external elements with a 
suitable non-combustible alternative that is suitable for relevant up-to-date regulations- works are to 
be in accordance with the recommendations made in the Fire Risk Appraisal of External Wall report. 
(FRAEW). The replaced elements will match the existing ones except for the glass panels, which will be 
replaced with metal panels - though maintaining a similar general appearance.
